function.description: This tool belongs to the vehicle control system, which allows users to control various aspects of the car such as engine, doors, climate control, lights, and more. Tool description: Estimates the distance between two cities.

cityA.description: The zipcode of the first city.

cityB.description: The zipcode of the second city.

distance.description: The distance between the two cities in km.

intermediaryCities.description: [Optional] The list of intermediary cities between the two cities.

messages.content: Using my vehicle's system, estimate the distance between Rivermist and Stonebrook.
